name: pnp-sharepoint-skills-information-architecture-review
title: Information Architecture Review
shortDescription: Evaluates the information architecture of a SharePoint site using read-only analysis and provides governance-oriented recommendations.
longDescription: Information Architecture Review performs a read-only assessment of a SharePoint site to evaluate how information is organized across document libraries, folders, metadata, pages, and navigation.

The skill identifies strengths, governance risks, and opportunities to improve discoverability, consistency, and scalability. It generates practical, evidence-based recommendations without modifying SharePoint content.
